_note: PROPOSED, ILLUSTRATIVE example. Not produced by working software; no implementation exists. People, companies and amounts are fictional. Content hashes are digests of descriptive labels, not of real files. All thresholds are proposed, uncalibrated defaults.

side_effects.detail: Captured and identified, but not compiled: no check type fits.

rationale: Captured and recognized as a standing instruction, but not turned into a rule: sales proposals have no "delivery lead time" field that a check could read. It is in the inbox so that a person can keep it as a note or dismiss it. Nothing is enforced.
